text: Standing in this brightly-lit, modern space, I am struck by a sense of anticipation and slight unease. The glass-walled meeting room, with its countdown timer visible through the reflection, makes time feel urgent and measured. Nearby, the colorful and dynamic display about research and development sparks my curiosity—here, human ingenuity and technology intermingle, inviting contemplation about our place amid rapid innovation. I feel both small and vital, an observer caught between quiet reflection and the hum of creative energy.
